patients.summary: Healthy software developer who joined the practice in 2023 for routine preventive care. In late 2025 a left dorsal wrist ganglion cyst was referred to orthopedics, diagnosed clinically, and aspirated in March 2026 without recurrence by her 2026 physical.

documents.title: New patient intake call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller: patient. Wants to transfer primary care to us. Membership paperwork emailed, she will sign online. Insurance employer PPO, card front/back uploaded to portal. No current meds per pt, no known allergies. Signed release faxed to her prior PCP office for last 3 yrs of notes, labs, immunizations. New patient physical booked 9/12 at 8:30. Told her to come fasting so labs can be drawn same week.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Fax received from prior PCP office, 22 pages, scanned to media.

Contents: visit notes 2020-2023 (annual exams only, all normal), immunization record, one Pap report.

Abstracted for the chart:
- Problem list: none
- Medications: none
- Allergies: NKDA
- Cervical cytology 06/2021: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy
- Tdap 05/14/2019
- COVID-19 Pfizer 04/20/2021 and 05/11/2021
- HPV vaccine series documented as completed in adolescence (dates not listed on their record)

Routed to PCP for review before new patient visit.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Hui Huang, 26F, new to the practice, transferring from her prior primary care office. Prior records reviewed (annual exams only, nothing abnormal). Here for a physical; no complaints.

PMH: none. PSH: none.
Meds: none. No supplements.
Allergies: NKDA.
FH: nothing significant that she knows of.
SH: software developer, mostly at a desk. Never smoked, alcohol a drink or two a month, no drug use.

ROS: negative on a full review. Menses regular.
PHQ-2: 0.

Exam: well appearing, in no distress. Vitals per flowsheet. HEENT unremarkable, TMs clear. Neck supple, no thyromegaly or lymphadenopathy. Heart regular rate and rhythm, no murmur. Lungs clear throughout. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses. Extremities without edema. Skin without suspicious lesions. Neuro grossly nonfocal. Mood and affect normal.

Health maintenance:
- Pap 06/2021 NILM at prior office. Next due 2024.
- Tdap 2019. COVID primary series 2021. HPV series complete per old records.
- Flu shot: will get it at a nurse visit next month once the new season's supply is in.
- HIV and hep C one-time screening: agreed, adding to labs.

A/P:
1. Adult wellness exam. Healthy. Baseline fasting CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH plus HIV and HCV screens; she'll come in Thursday morning for the draw.
2. Return in one year for annual, sooner as needed. Texting the office is fine for small things.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Hui, your labs from Thursday all came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, sugar, thyroid and cholesterol are all where they should be. The HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative, and those are one-time tests, so you won't need to repeat them unless something changes. Nice to have you with us. See you at the flu shot visit next month.

documents.title: Immunization
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pt in for seasonal influenza vaccine. Feeling well today, no fever. No prior reactions to vaccines. NKDA, no latex or egg issues. Current VIS given. Influenza quadrivalent 0.5 mL IM, left deltoid. Tolerated without issue, waited 15 min in lobby, left ambulatory. She plans to get the updated COVID shot at her pharmacy.

documents.title: Pharmacy immunization notification
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Notification from retail pharmacy via state registry: COVID-19 vaccine, Pfizer 2023-2024 formula, given 10/26/2023, right deltoid. Added to immunization history.

documents.title: Vaccine record
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, my company's HR is updating employee health records and wants a copy of my vaccines. Is there a way to get a printout? Thanks, Hui

documents.title: RE: Vaccine record
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Hui, I put your immunization record in the documents section of the portal, you can download it as a PDF. It includes the old records from your previous office plus the flu and COVID shots from the fall. Let us know if HR needs anything else.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
27F, annual. Doing well. No ER/UC visits, no new meds this year. Work busy but manageable.

Meds: none. Allergies: NKDA.
SH unchanged: never smoker, alcohol 1-2/month.
ROS negative. LMP 2 wks ago, regular.
PHQ-9 2, GAD-7 1.

Exam: vitals reviewed, normal. Well appearing. HEENT clear. Neck no nodes, thyroid normal size. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen benign. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, vagina and cervix normal appearing, Pap collected; bimanual without tenderness or masses. Skin unremarkable. Extremities normal.

A/P:
1. Annual exam, healthy adult. CBC and CMP drawn today. Lipids normal last year, not repeating.
2. Cervical cancer screening: Pap today, last one 2021.
3. Flu shot given today, she'd rather not come back for it. COVID booster at her pharmacy as last year.
4. RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: Pap and blood work
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Hui - good news all around. Pap smear is normal. With a normal result at your age, the next one is due in three years (2027). Blood count and chemistry panel from Tuesday are normal as well. Nothing to do until next year's physical.

documents.title: Pharmacy immunization notification
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Registry update: COVID-19 vaccine 2024-2025 formula (Pfizer) administered at retail pharmacy 10/22/2024, left deltoid. Immunization history updated.
